Made for the everyday

Your paperwork.
A lighter workflow.

A receipt, a page of notes, a PDF. Make your documents easier to read, find and share.

Capture or import

Take a photo using your camera app, or import JPG, PNG, WebP and unencrypted PDF files.

Every page, together

Build documents with up to 3 pages for free. Pro supports up to 25 on-device or 10 with Datalab. Cloud usage limits also apply. Add, reorder or remove pages before recognition.

Clean up your scans

Adjust the crop manually, rotate in 90° steps and try grayscale to prepare your page.

Text you can work with

Recognize text locally in 13 languages. Read Formatted, Text or Markdown results. Optional Datalab processing is being prepared for richer cloud results.

Find it again

Search document names and recognized text in your history. Mark important documents as favorites.

Share it your way

Share text with an app you choose, or save a TXT, Markdown or HTML file using Android’s file picker.

From page to useful text

Four steps.
One less thing to do.

  1. 01

    Bring in your document

    Tap Scan a document to use your camera, or Import image or PDF to select a file.

  2. 02

    Put the pages in order

    Add pages if you need them. Use Crop and enhance to adjust edges, rotation or grayscale.

  3. 03

    Choose how to recognize

    Choose On-device and the document language, then tap Recognize document. When Datalab becomes available, it will require sign-in and your upload confirmation; document languages are detected automatically.

  4. 04

    Read, keep and share

    Check the result, then tap Share text or Export. Find the saved document later in History.

On-device · Available offline

Choose from 13 document languages. Recognition runs on your phone without an app account or internet. Scans and results stay in your local history.

Datalab · In preparation

When available, choose Datalab, sign in with Google and confirm the document upload. Prepared pages will be sent to our Cloudflare server and Datalab. Document languages are detected automatically.

Your choice, per document

Cloud recognition will ask before uploading. A failed cloud request will not silently change engines. Our server copies expire after 24 hours with scheduled cleanup; Datalab retention follows its own policy.

Good to know

Small questions.
Clear answers.

Everything you need before your first scan.

Visit support
Does OCR Scanner work without internet?

Yes, with the on-device engine. Its models are included, so import, recognition, search and local document features work offline without an app account. Buying or restoring Pro needs internet and your Samsung account. Optional Datalab cloud OCR is in preparation and will require internet, Google sign-in and upload confirmation. Ads, privacy messages and configuration also use internet.

Which languages can I recognize?

The interface and on-device OCR support English, French, Arabic, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, Hindi, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Choose the matching document language for local OCR. Datalab, when available, will detect document languages automatically. Arabic has right-to-left interface support.

Can I import a multi-page PDF?

Yes. Import an unencrypted PDF. Free supports up to 3 pages per document. Pro supports up to 25 pages on-device or 10 with Datalab when available; server usage limits also apply to cloud processing. Add, reorder or remove pages before recognition. JPG, PNG and WebP are also supported.

Will my scanned PDF look exactly the same?

On-device OCR extracts text with simple formatting and does not reconstruct complex tables or embedded images. Optional Datalab processing can return richer formatting and extracted content when supported, but identical layout is not guaranteed. The app does not export PDF or searchable PDF. TXT export is free; Markdown and HTML file exports require Pro.

What makes recognition more accurate?

Use sharp, well-lit images with readable text. Keep the page upright, crop out unnecessary edges, choose the matching language and review the output. Low-quality photos, complex layouts and handwriting can produce errors.

How do I delete a document?

Open it and use Delete document to remove local pages and results. Exported or shared files must be deleted from their destinations. Local deletion does not guarantee immediate cloud deletion. Our server copies expire 24 hours after job creation with scheduled cleanup; Datalab retention follows its own policy.

Which phones are supported?

The current signed Galaxy release targets ARM64 Android devices running Android 8.0 or later. Compatibility can vary by device and is determined by the app’s store listing.
